parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The schedule description. The description must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The description must be unique within the instance.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end date of the schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. The end date cannot be earlier than the start date specified by StartDate.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The schedule name. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance.

parameters.name: OpenType
parameters.description:
The open type of the schedule.

- Internal (default): Set the value to **INNER**. Only devices within the instance where the schedule resides can request sound code decoding.

- Public: Set the value to **OPEN**. You can configure a whitelist by sending emails to allow devices from other instances to request sound code decoding. The usage of cross-instance decoding is calculated under the instance where the sound code resides.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date of the schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
